Victron Pi HAT v29.5 - 85 x 56 mm, 4 layers. Drag = rotate, right-drag / shift-drag = pan, wheel = zoom. Parts are simplified boxes from the PCB data (real positions, nominal heights); board artwork is the real render. Fan: 30 x 30 x 10 mm on the TOP, over the 28 mm cutout, M2.5 screws with nuts on the bottom. Pi 5 and its cooler are illustrative only. TLP290-4 opto inputs, buzzer on top; v29.5: PCF8523 RTC on the bottom, 1.5 F coin supercap C903 upright on the top (20 mm), stack-up 1/0.5/0.5/1 oz, no fuses (fuse the + wire).
